headline: Seven and the wall still holds.
body: The kettle clicks off one floor down. No second van appears. The same line waits on the open page.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: thin grey just clearing the chimney pots

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: empty, wet patch shrinking by the drain

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: lamp circle steady, room one degree cooler
